title: Sindh Civil Servants Assessment of Suitability of Appointments Ordinance 2001

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Civil Servants Assessment of Suitability of Appointments Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

ORDINANCE VII OF 2001
SINDH CIVIL
SERVANTS (ASSESSMENT OF SUITABILITY OF APPOINTMENTS) ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE VII OF 2001
An Ordinance to p
for assessment of suitability of the persons appointed to the specified posts
without reference to the Commission and the persons appointed to the service by
transfer who were not otherwise eligible for transfer under the Rules
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 20th January; 2001]
No. S.Legis.1(7)/2001, dated
20-1-2001.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby
published for general information:
1. Short title, extent and
commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Sindh Civil Servants
(Assessment of Suitability of Appointment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

2. Definitions.--In this
Ordinance, unless the context otherwise requires.---
(a)
"Commission" means the Sindh Public Service Commission;
(b)
"Rules" means the West Pakistan Civil Service (Executive Branch) Rules,
1964, as applicable to Sindh;
(c)
"Service" means the service as defined in the Rules;
(d)
"specified post" means--
(i) a post in
BPS-16 or above specified under rule 5 of the Sindh Public Service Commission
Functions Rules, and filled without reference to the Commission; or
(ii) a post in
the Service filled by transfer under rule 5(5)(c) of the Rules of the persons
not holding the posts mentioned in that rule on regular basis.

3. Reference to Commission.--Any
person appointed to a specified post, during the period from 1985 to 1997, and
is in employment in any capacity on the commencement of this Ordinance shall,
notwithstanding anything contained in any law rules or any decree order
injunction or judgment of a Court, be required to appear before the Commission
for interview and written test for the assessment of his suitability for the
specified post and the person concerned shall comply with the directions.

4. Termination of service.--Where
the person concerned fails to comply with the directions issued to him under
section 3 or he is not found suitable for the specified post the service of
such person shall stand terminated with immediate effect from the date he fails
to comply with the directions, or as the case may be, from the date of the
announcement of the results by the Commission.

6. Bar of jurisdiction and
abatement of suits.---No Court shall have jurisdiction to entertain any
proceedings- grant any injunction or make any order in relation to any
directions issued or made or anything done or intended to be done under this
Ordinance and all suits, appeals and applications pending in this behalf shall
abate on the coining into force of this Ordinance.
